title: Fitness PNG still-image player characterization

input.provenance: Pre-existing local image reported by the user as manually opened in Kinovea; not committed.

preconditions: Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix and matching Kinovea executable.
No Kinovea window may already be open.
The logged-in KWin/Xwayland session and required automation tools must be available.

actions.description: Capture Kinovea at startup before opening media.
Open the fixture through the shortcut route.
Capture the main window after the open action returned.
Verify that the player header identifies this image and its dimensions.
Capture the first stable view of the opened still image.
Request one frame step forward using the default keyboard action.
Capture the visible result of frame stepping.
Capture the visible result after stepping back.
Test the source-configured Ctrl+F4 close shortcut while the player is active.
Record whether the Ctrl+F4 shortcut closed the player.
Determine whether Ctrl+F4 removed the active still-image player.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 only to the Kinovea window launched by this run; never calls wineserver -k.
evidenceConfidence: OCR checks only visible player header metadata; a human reviews presentation and controls.
limitations: OCR can produce false negatives and is not a pixel or numerical equivalence test.
Frame-step screenshots do not establish exact timestamps.
Screenshots do not establish alpha values or premultiplication.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Ctrl+O opens the local fitness PNG in a Kinovea player with filename, 276x398 dimensions and 25.00 fps.
expectedOutcomes.verification: OCR assertion and manual review of the player screenshot.

expectedOutcomes.observation: The portrait image is shown on a black canvas with the regular timeline, navigation and drawing toolbar.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Manual review of the window screenshot; no pixel or alpha claim.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Right/Left requests are sent; exact navigation state is not inferred from the raster.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Compare screenshots for visible UI changes only; exact timestamps remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
NOT_ESTABLISHED; a post-request OCR assertion records if the header remains.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Player close followed by reopening the same image.
expectedOutcomes.verification: NOT_ESTABLISHED; no reliable close interaction was found.
